name: git-whiteboard-app
description: Web app to visualize Git functionality in a Git history graph for training purposes

paragraphs: The Git Whiteboard App is a stateless (i.e. purely client-side) web application that allows you to quickly and easily create Git graphs in your browser for demonstration purposes. The application is designed to provide all the visual possibilities that are usually required on a whiteboard to draw Git graphs: Commit graphs, HEAD, branch and tag labels, simplified commit IDs, commits which are lost in the reflog, etc. The handling must be quick and easy, so that during a Git training course, for example, you can create a simple demo Git graph with a few mouse clicks to explain a specific Git…
